items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: I went out there with O'Rell. I didn't play with nobody but O'Rell.

ctx.x: You mentioned then when you went to California, were there any other bands before you went out there, though, that you can tell us about that you played with?

No, I went out there with O'Rell. I didn't play with nobody but O'Rell. No, I didn't play with nobody but O'Rell. After the band broke up, well they raid the nightclubs, wherever that's so much, you know, and the bands broke up. And I got a job working for the railroad, working cleaning cars for the South Pacific a while. O'Rell, O'Rell, Wade, and Mutt, a guy taking them to Los Angeles, I don't know whether it was Los Angeles or Frisco, a guy that called Curtis Molesby. I guess you heard of him out there. He had…
I was waiting for the railroad there and got my job waiting for the railroad there. So you stayed out there there? A while.
